item.casualtinkering.circular_saw.descri: A versatile tool that functions as a hand axe for woodcutting and a melee weapon. Right-click to charge a spinning attack that damages enemies in a cone.
modifier.casualtinkering.circular_saw_at: Hold right-click to rapidly slice enemies in a cone. Low damage per hit, but at very high frequency.
modifier.casualtinkering.magic_sword.des: A fully charged melee strike summons magical swords to pierce the target. Higher levels summon more swords for increased total damage.
modifier.casualtinkering.magic_sword_con: Hold right-click to charge, then release to summon magical swords at a target within 8 blocks. Higher levels summon more swords for increased total damage.
modifier.casualtinkering.magic_sword_aut: Periodically summons a magical sword to strike the nearest enemy within 9 blocks. Higher levels shorten the interval and increase total damage.
modifier.casualtinkering.magic_sword_coo: When held in offhand, your mainhand attacks summon magical swords to assist. Higher levels summon more swords with increased total damage.
modifier.casualtinkering.thermal_ray.des: Fires a beam using the fluid in its tank. Smeltery fuels deal full damage and set targets ablaze; other hot fluids deal half damage but apply their fluid effects. Fluids below 400K cannot be fired.
item.casualtinkering.throwing_knife.desc:
A throwing weapon with lower base stats but more component parts.
Sticks in blocks for retrieval.
Sneak with 3+ knives to throw a 3-way horizontal spread.
modifier.casualtinkering.boomerang.descr: Right-click to throw the weapon; it returns after a short flight. Higher levels apply tool traits on hit.
modifier.casualtinkering.triple_shot.des: Sneak and throw with at least 3 of the same ammo to release a horizontal three-way spread.
item.casualtinkering.boomerang.descripti:
A balanced throwing weapon that returns to the thrower. Effective for both melee and ranged combat.
Right Click: Throw – returns after hitting a foe, a block, or traveling a short distance.
item.casualtinkering.heat_ray_gun.descri:
A high-tech energy weapon that consumes hot fluids to fire a devastating beam.
Charge up with right click – overheat after 10 shots.
item.casualtinkering.gunblade.descriptio:
An ancient weapon forged in one piece: a sword blade with a barrel running through its spine.
Recovered only from the chests of ancient cities.
modifier.casualtinkering.gunblade.descri: Melee hits load 1 bullet, up to 3. Right-click fires fast bullets inheriting tool traits; each shot costs 1 durability. Has a 1-slot chamber for Tinkers throwables and arrows: throws the ammo itself when loaded. Sneak-use to open the chamber.
modifier.casualtinkering.sniping.descrip: Deals bonus damage based on hit distance, +1% per block up to 10 blocks.
modifier.casualtinkering.concealment.fla: What you cannot see, you cannot hit
modifier.casualtinkering.concealment.des: Each level reduces incoming damage by 0.5% per block of distance from the attacker, up to 5%.
material.casualtinkering.quartziron.ency: +1% damage per block of distance, up to 10 blocks.
material.casualtinkering.quartziron.flav: An iron body with a quartz heart.
fluid.casualtinkering.molten_verdant_ste: Moss and molten metal settle their differences in a single furnace.
modifier.casualtinkering.oversiphon.flav: Experience is just another kind of slime
modifier.casualtinkering.oversiphon.desc: Each level siphons experience orbs into overslime. Orbs are converted by value, up to 2+level points at once, with a 5 second cooldown.
material.casualtinkering.verdant_steel.e: Siphons picked-up experience orbs into overslime: each orb restores half its value rounded up, up to 2+level points before a 5 second cooldown.
material.casualtinkering.verdant_steel.f: Copper green, grass green, slime green. Green all the same.
